response-complete.description: Plays notification sound when Claude finishes responding

task-complete.description: Plays notification sound when specific tasks are marked complete

long-task-complete.command: powershell -c "[console]::beep(523,200); [console]::beep(659,200); [console]::beep(784,400); msg '%username%' /TIME:10 'Claude has completed a long-running task!'"
